mission: Frank v0.1 voll lauffähig auf Andreas PC

fresh_state_findings.wp02: Selected V17 has complete Hostinger Ubuntu proxy closure but remains formally OPEN pending the registered Andreas Ubuntu developer-system target receipt.
fresh_state_findings.wp03_upstream: Original V7 typed-fn grammar independently reproduces a strict LALR shift/reduce conflict at optional dotted_relation.
fresh_state_findings.wp03_downstream: Current-main typed IR loses grammar-admitted reserved-word identifiers by value-based keyword filtering; the AST-context candidate preserves them.
fresh_state_findings.runner_topology: The active Hostinger self-hosted runner is repository-scoped to gschaidergabriel/Dr.-Unterweger; Clay-repo self-hosted jobs are not a valid execution lane under the observed configuration.

supported_points: Lark strict=True raises on unresolved LALR shift/reduce and regex collisions.
Rule priorities are a documented LALR collision-resolution mechanism.
Lark advises avoiding rules that match the same sequence where possible; terminal priority should be a last resort.
The contextual lexer narrows terminal choices from parser state, so grammar structure remains a primary ambiguity-control surface.
live_external_knowledge.architecture_effect: Prefer the minimum structural repair that preserves the already-selected V17 relation membrane over broad lexer novelty without an executable counterexample.

hypothesis: The WP03 blockers are separable: preserve V7 typed-fn/operator semantics, replace only its optional dotted relation with the selected V17 relation membrane, and use AST context rather than token value to extract grammar-admitted identifiers.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The two repairs interact and either reintroduce a strict grammar conflict, break frozen G9/Dialect or Needle boundaries, collapse + and - identity, destabilize typed semantic IDs, or accidentally mint declaration authority.

wp03_keyword_result.upstream_error: GrammarError: Shift/Reduce conflict for terminal IFF in dotted_relation

baseline_and_counterevidence.v19_negative_result: Exact current V19 delimiter-consuming no-lookahead design was refuted by V17-valid bare-qid trailing-trivia/comment statement-boundary cases; production V17 remained selected.

out_of_box_experiment.name: SEMANTIC_HASH_VS_SOURCE_SPAN_DUAL_RAIL

out_of_box_experiment.reason: Stronger concurrent statement-boundary counterevidence refuted exact V19 before this could support V19; the source-span separation remains a future frontend diagnostic test obligation independent of V19.
out_of_box_experiment.rollback: Deleted the wrong-scope Clay-repo self-hosted workflow after runner-scope discovery; retained only the reversible probe as reproducible research material.

targeted_distribution.message: Do not merge stale draft as-is; port only the minimal supported AST-context delta to fresh main and replay canonical validation with exact provenance.

V19 delimiter-consuming design repaired prefix shadow but broke V17-valid statement-boundary trivia/comment semantics.
A self-hosted job declared in the Clay repository is not evidence of Hostinger execution while the runner remains repository-scoped to Dr.-Unterweger.
A green Hostinger research composition does not equal formal WP03 PASS or Andreas target acceptance.

Run canonical WP03 validation plus differential equivalence under the selected exact grammar/frontend/typed-IR provenance.
Add source-span/diagnostic provenance tests as a separate non-semantic rail before WP04 precise diagnostics depend on it.
